title: Canonical derived restriction maps for nested open subschemes
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let $W\subseteq U$ be open subschemes. On the derived module categories [def-pc-derived-category], let $r_U:D(\mathcal O_X)\to D(\mathcal O_U)$ be exact restriction, encoded by SheafOfModules.overFunctor followed by Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U, and let $t:D(\mathcal O_U)\to D(\mathcal O_W)$ be restriction between the opens, encoded by the inverse of overEquiv U, overMap for $W\subseteq U$, and overEquiv W. Let $\alpha:t\circ r_U\xrightarrow{\sim}r_W$ be the canonical composition isomorphism induced by the unit isomorphism of overEquiv U and overFunctorMap. For adjunctions $a_U:r_U\dashv Rj_{U*}$ and $a_W:r_W\dashv Rj_{W*}$ with the derived direct images of [def-pc-derived-direct-image], define $\rho_{U,W}(E):Rj_{U*}r_U(E)\to Rj_{W*}r_W(E)$ to be the $a_W$-adjoint of the composite $r_W(Rj_{U*}r_U(E))\xrightarrow{\alpha^{-1}}t(r_U(Rj_{U*}r_U(E)))\xrightarrow{t(\epsilon_U)}t(r_U(E))\xrightarrow{\alpha}r_W(E)$, where $\epsilon_U$ is the counit of $a_U$. The exactness instances for overFunctor and overMap are those of [lem-sc-derived-hom-mayer-vietoris].
